name: microsoft-365
description: Team Assistant MCP: an AI-native MCP server giving governed read/write access to Planner (including Goals), Teams, SharePoint and OneNote over Microsoft Graph. Self-hosted, per-tenant, delegated sign-in — no central service, no admin-consent-for-others.

interface.shortDescription: Give Codex governed access to Planner, Teams, SharePoint and OneNote over Microsoft Graph.
interface.longDescription: An MCP server for everyday Microsoft 365 work: Planner (task and goal management, OKR-style — start from a goal, build the tasks that serve it), Teams (read), SharePoint Lists (read/write by internal column name), and OneNote (rich HTML pages with color, styling, inline images and attachments, not flat text). Self-hosted per tenant with delegated device-code sign-in — every call acts as the signed-in user, nothing is proxied through a shared service. Deliberately excludes Premium Planner / Dataverse ("Project"), which is a separate plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show me the goals on this Planner plan, and the tasks linked to each one.
Create a Planner goal and build out the tasks under it.
Show me my open Planner tasks across every plan.
Create a OneNote page with headings, color, and an inline image from this content.
Append this to my meeting notes page in OneNote.
